_provenance.notes: GOA Sablefish (Anoplopoma fimbria, black cod) is managed under IFQ with a distinct GOA area allocation. It is Alaska's most valuable per-pound groundfish at $8.20/lb ex-vessel in 2024. GOA Rockfish includes multiple species: Pacific Ocean Perch (POP — Sebastes alutus, the dominant species), Northern Rockfish, Dusky Rockfish, Rougheye/Blackspotted Rockfish, and Shortspine Thornyhead. POP are extremely long-lived (100+ years) and managed very conservatively. The Rockfish Program in SEAK (2010) allows ADF&G management of rockfish in state waters with a community-based allocation system.
